rules.message: Unresolved debug or placeholder marker in changed code
Hardcoded secret or private credential detected
Changed implementation must include a regression test
Conflict marker or unfilled scaffold remains

criteria: Does the implementation cover every requirement in the FSA-CLS control/data-plane specification?
Are authentication, tenant ownership, and database boundaries enforced server-side?
Is migration non-destructive, repeatable, and free of plaintext credential handling?
rules.message: Implementation must satisfy the approved design and security boundaries

criteria: Do tests assert meaningful default, compatibility, and migration mapping behavior?
Do verification results include an idempotent migration and preserved assessment row counts?
rules.message: Regression tests and migration evidence should cover principal failure modes
